newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH LOCAL DEVELOPMENT MINISTER RESIGNS - AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH LOCAL DEVELOPMENT MINISTER RESIGNS - AGENCY.

text.p: Czech Minister for Local Development Jaromir Schneider of the junior coalition Christian Democratic Party (KDU-CSL) resigned on Tuesday, news agency CTK said.
CTK reported that Schneider stepped down after he lost the confidence of his party which had called for his resignation.
Schneider, 59, became a member of the three-party coalition cabinet after last June's election.
The agency quoted KDU-CSL chairman and Agriculture Minister Josef Lux as saying that Schneider was a weak point in the cabinet.
KDU has four seats in the 16-member cabinet, the same number as the right-wing Civic Democratic Alliance (ODA). The Civic Democratic Party (ODS) led by Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus has eight seats.
